name: Hideout
content: The Hideout in Gray Zone Warfare is the players's personal workspace. It consists of several rooms, each dedicated to creating different types of items. To make full use of the Hideout, the player needs to build and upgrade stations within its rooms. These stations expand the capabilities of individual rooms and allow the player to perform more complex pipelines. The player also needs to acquire recipes, which provide the knowledge needed to create specific items in the Hideout. / Heat Source Extraction Vessel Reaction Vessel Filtration Analysis Glassware 9 Available Power 2 Steel Disassembly is a specialized pipeline that allows the player to dismantle complex devices into their components.To disassemble an item, the player must move it from their Locker into the disassembly grid. Items in the grid are disassembled sequentially, with priority given to those closest to the top-left corner. The time required to disassemble each item is displayed on the disassembly button.\n\nMoving an item within the grid or returning it to the Locker resets its disassembly time.Items obtained through disassembly are stored in the Electronics Workshop storage space.Disassembly continues even while the player is offline.
